product_overview: DClaw Finance is an AI-augmented financial operations backend for invoice, expense, budget, forecasting, reporting, and chat-driven analysis. It helps finance teams track performance, generate insights, and automate routine financial workflows through REST APIs.
core_goals: Provide CRUD APIs for invoices, expenses, budgets, and supporting financial entities
Deliver AI-assisted workflows for line-item suggestions, receipt OCR, expense categorization, reminders, reports, and chat assistance
Surface financial health through dashboard, trend, forecast, client profitability, and budget utilization endpoints
Maintain persistent financial records in PostgreSQL with schema-managed migrations
Support reliable service operations with a dedicated health check endpoint

features.name: Invoice Management API
features.description: Allows users to create, view, update, delete, and enrich invoices with line items, AI suggestions, and reminder drafts.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/invoices with valid client_name, amount, and due_date -> Receive 201 with InvoiceResponse containing the new invoice -> GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id} -> Receive 200 with the saved invoice and status details

POST /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/items with a line item description, quantity, and unit_price -> Receive 201 with InvoiceItemResponse -> PUT /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/items/{item_id} with revised quantity -> Receive 200 with updated InvoiceItemResponse

POST /api/v1/invoices/suggest-items with invoice context -> Receive 200 with a list of suggested InvoiceItem entries -> POST /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/items for each accepted suggestion -> Receive 201 for each added line item
GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id} for a non-existent invoice -> Receive 404 Not Found -> PUT /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id} with update data -> Receive 404 Not Found

POST /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/reminder-draft for an invoice in sent or overdue status -> Receive 200 with AI-generated reminder text -> DELETE /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id} -> Receive 204 No Content

POST /api/v1/invoices with invalid or missing required fields -> Receive 422 Validation Error -> GET /api/v1/invoices to confirm no invalid invoice was created -> Receive 200 with the current invoice list

features.name: Expense Management API
features.description: Supports expense CRUD, receipt OCR extraction, AI categorization, and anomaly detection for outlier review.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/expenses/ocr with a receipt image file -> Receive 200 with extracted ExpenseOCRResult -> POST /api/v1/expenses with OCR-derived fields -> Receive 201 with ExpenseResponse

POST /api/v1/expenses/categorize with description and vendor text -> Receive 200 with a suggested category string -> POST /api/v1/expenses with the selected category -> Receive 201 with ExpenseResponse
GET /api/v1/expenses/anomalies -> Receive 200 with a list of anomalous ExpenseResponse records -> GET /api/v1/expenses/{expense_id} for a flagged expense -> Receive 200 with the expense detail

POST /api/v1/expenses with valid category, description, amount, and date -> Receive 201 with ExpenseResponse -> PUT /api/v1/expenses/{expense_id} with corrected amount or vendor -> Receive 200 with updated ExpenseResponse -> DELETE /api/v1/expenses/{expense_id} -> Receive 204 No Content
GET /api/v1/expenses/{expense_id} for a missing expense -> Receive 404 Not Found -> PUT /api/v1/expenses/{expense_id} for the same missing ID -> Receive 404 Not Found

POST /api/v1/expenses with invalid category or malformed date -> Receive 422 Validation Error -> GET /api/v1/expenses to verify only valid expenses are listed -> Receive 200 with the current expense list

features.name: Budget Management API
features.description: Lets users create, update, list, and delete budgets, and review utilization status for category-based spending control.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/budgets with category, monthly_limit, year, and month -> Receive 200 with BudgetResponse -> GET /api/v1/budgets -> Receive 200 with the list including the new budget
GET /api/v1/budgets/status -> Receive 200 with BudgetStatus showing utilization -> PUT /api/v1/budgets/{budget_id} with a higher monthly_limit -> Receive 200 with updated BudgetResponse

POST /api/v1/budgets with the same category, year, and month as an existing budget -> Receive 200 with the upserted BudgetResponse and updated limit -> GET /api/v1/budgets/status -> Receive 200 with refreshed utilization
DELETE /api/v1/budgets/{budget_id} -> Receive 204 No Content -> GET /api/v1/budgets/{budget_id} equivalent list lookup -> Receive 404 or absence in the list response
PUT /api/v1/budgets/{budget_id} for a non-existent budget -> Receive 404 Not Found or equivalent failure response -> DELETE /api/v1/budgets/{budget_id} for the same ID -> Receive 404 Not Found
POST /api/v1/budgets with missing month or invalid monthly_limit -> Receive validation error response -> GET /api/v1/budgets -> Receive 200 with unchanged budgets

features.name: Dashboard API
features.description: Provides financial summary KPIs and trend data for operational monitoring and reporting.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/dashboard -> Receive 200 with revenue, expenses, and profit summary -> GET /api/v1/dashboard/trends -> Receive 200 with time-series trend data
GET /api/v1/dashboard/trends with no data available -> Receive 200 with an empty or zeroed trend dataset -> GET /api/v1/dashboard -> Receive 200 with summary values reflecting no activity
GET /api/v1/dashboard -> Receive 200 with KPI totals -> Use the returned metrics to compare revenue and expenses across the current period
GET /api/v1/dashboard/trends -> Receive 200 with 12-month trend points -> Refresh the dashboard summary by calling GET /api/v1/dashboard -> Receive 200 with updated aggregate metrics

features.name: Reports API
features.description: Generates AI-written monthly financial summary reports for a selected year and month.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/reports/monthly-summary with year and month -> Receive 200 with ReportResponse containing executive summary and financial KPIs
POST /api/v1/reports/monthly-summary with an invalid month value -> Receive validation error response -> Retry with valid year and month -> Receive 200 with ReportResponse
POST /api/v1/reports/monthly-summary with a period that has no transactions -> Receive 200 with a report reflecting minimal or zero activity
POST /api/v1/reports/monthly-summary twice for the same month -> Receive 200 both times with a generated report response each time

features.name: Client Profitability API
features.description: Returns ranked profitability metrics for clients, including revenue, outstanding balances, and composite scores.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/clients/profitability -> Receive 200 with a ranked list of ClientProfitability records
GET /api/v1/clients/profitability -> Receive 200 with client scores that can be used to identify high-value and low-value accounts
GET /api/v1/clients/profitability when no client data exists -> Receive 200 with an empty list
GET /api/v1/clients/profitability -> Receive 200 with profitability metrics -> Select a client entry for follow-up analysis in the UI
GET /api/v1/clients/profitability after new invoice activity is recorded -> Receive 200 with updated ranking and totals

features.name: Forecast API
features.description: Provides statistical financial projections for revenue, expenses, and profit over a forecast horizon.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/forecast -> Receive 200 with ForecastResponse containing projected revenue, expenses, and profit
GET /api/v1/forecast when historical data is limited -> Receive 200 with a forecast response that reflects reduced confidence
GET /api/v1/forecast -> Receive 200 with forecasted values that can be compared against dashboard totals
GET /api/v1/forecast after new expense and invoice data is added -> Receive 200 with refreshed projections

features.name: AI Chat API
features.description: Enables conversational financial queries with persisted message history.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/chat with a user message -> Receive 200 with ChatResponse from the financial assistant -> GET /api/v1/chat/history -> Receive 200 with the stored message history

GET /api/v1/chat/history with prior conversations present -> Receive 200 with a list of ChatMessage records -> POST /api/v1/chat with a follow-up question -> Receive 200 with a context-aware assistant response
POST /api/v1/chat with an empty message -> Receive validation error response -> GET /api/v1/chat/history -> Receive 200 with unchanged history
POST /api/v1/chat repeatedly with financial questions -> Receive 200 for each message and persist the conversation -> GET /api/v1/chat/history -> Receive 200 with the recent message timeline

features.name: Health Check
features.description: Exposes a simple liveness probe for operational monitoring and deployment validation.
user_flows: GET /health -> Receive 200 with {"status":"ok","service":"dclaw-finance"}
GET /health during normal service operation -> Receive 200 confirming the backend is live
GET /health after deployment -> Receive 200 to verify readiness of the service endpoint

tech_stack.other: Pydantic v2, Alembic, Anthropic Claude API, Docker
